# Telemark Digital Apify Monitoring Workflows

Public, credential-free packages for three Apify monitoring Actors and their workflow examples.

## Products

- Bluesky Keyword & Mention Alerts: https://apify.com/uplifted_novice_vbl/bluesky-keyword-mention-alerts
  - Public examples: https://apify.com/uplifted_novice_vbl/bluesky-keyword-mention-alerts/examples
  - Local package: bluesky-keyword-mention-alerts/
  - Plugin package: plugins/bluesky-keyword-alerts/
- RSS Keyword Monitor: https://apify.com/uplifted_novice_vbl/rss-keyword-monitor-only-new
  - Public examples: https://apify.com/uplifted_novice_vbl/rss-keyword-monitor-only-new/examples
  - Local package: rss-keyword-monitor/
  - Plugin package: plugins/rss-keyword-monitor/
- TED Tender Monitor: https://apify.com/uplifted_novice_vbl/ted-tender-watch
  - Public examples: https://apify.com/uplifted_novice_vbl/ted-tender-watch/examples
  - Local package: ted-tender-monitor/
  - Plugin package: plugins/ted-tender-monitor/

## Public Workflow Surfaces

- Live n8n RSS template: https://n8n.io/workflows/17430-monitor-rss-feeds-with-apify-and-store-new-items-in-data-tables/
- Live n8n TED template: https://n8n.io/workflows/18030-monitor-eu-ted-tenders-with-apify-and-store-notices-in-n8n-data-tables/
- Live n8n Bluesky template: https://n8n.io/workflows/18103-monitor-bluesky-keyword-posts-with-apify-and-data-tables/
- Live Make shared scenarios are linked from README.md.
- AI client plugin packages are under plugins/ and expose one fixed Telemark gateway route per Actor.
- Official MCP Registry entries are live for all three product routes.
- Smithery external Streamable HTTP listings are live for all three product routes.
- Glama connector pages are discovered but currently show `Unhealthy`; the public MCP ownership, server-card, and OAuth protected-resource metadata routes are live.

## Usage Boundary

- Public example Tasks are bounded discovery previews.
- Recurring monitoring should use a persistent saved Apify Task with the documented cap for that product.
- These files contain no Apify tokens, webhook URLs, private credentials, or destination account bindings.
